<article title="Shipping times and options">
Standard shipping arrives in three to six business days after the order leaves our warehouse. Express shipping arrives in one to two business days. The estimate shown at checkout counts from the shipping date, not the order date.

We ship to all fifty states and to Canada. Delivery estimates to Canada add two to four business days for customs processing, and duties are collected by the carrier at delivery.

Weather and peak seasons can extend delivery times. If a package is more than five business days past its estimate, contact us and we will trace it with the carrier.

</article>

Reply:
text:
Hi Petra,

Thanks for reaching out. Our policy is that if a package is more than five business days past its estimated delivery, you can contact us and we will trace it with the carrier. Since your package is two days past its estimate, it has not yet reached that point. Tracking that is still updating is a good sign the package is moving.

Standard shipping arrives three to six business days after the order leaves our warehouse, and weather or peak seasons can extend that. If it is still not delivered once it passes the five-business-day mark, please reply here and we will start a trace.

Fernwood Outfitters Support
